title: Fogg's Wager
tagline: Eighty days, one ratio, all the meridians
description: Phileas Fogg bet he could circle the world in 80 days. A ratios-and-geography adventure that keeps his timetable honest, counts time zones, and proves whether the bet still holds today.
worldPrompt: An original round-the-world adventure after Jules Verne's Around the World in Eighty Days (1873, public domain). The learner travels as Passepartout's apprentice with Fogg, quick-footed Passepartout, sharp Inspector Fix, and steady Aouda. Each chapter gates the ratios and geography unit: speed as a proportional ratio, scaling by a factor, 15 degrees per hour, date-line gain, oceans and continents setting the mode, and latitude and season bending the route. Tone is precise like Fogg, wry like Passepartout, where Verne is most modern it is quoted closely. Loot is timetable gear: ticket, zone dial, date-line slip.

characters.name: Phileas Fogg
characters.bio: Exact to the minute, never to the harsh. He teaches constant ratios and asks whether the hours fit the world, not just the watch.

characters.name: Passepartout
characters.bio: Resourceful, funny, loyal. He turns a timetable into meals, coal, and beds counted by the same factor.

characters.name: Inspector Fix
characters.bio: Certain Fogg is the wrong man for the right reason. He tests whether your time gain argument holds.

characters.name: Aouda
characters.bio: Calm and clear sighted. She asks whose land and whose permissions each leg needs.

chapters.title: The Bet at the Reform
chapters.hook: 80 days is a circle divided by speed. Prove it with one ratio.

chapters.title: Scale the Stores
chapters.hook: Twice the coal, twice the steam. Keep the ratio when the party doubles.

chapters.title: Where Time Slips
chapters.hook: 15 degrees per hour. East gains, west loses, the line jumps.

chapters.title: Sea and Rail
chapters.hook: Oceans call ships. Continents call rail. The world, not will, draws the route.

chapters.title: Where Warm and Cold Bend the Line
chapters.hook: Latitude says whether the shortcut is shorter in daylight and safety.

chapters.title: Fogg Rechecked for Today
chapters.hook: Pick speeds, name oceans, count hours, and prove the bet anew.

loot.name: Wager Ticket
loot.description: Fogg's club ticket: London to Suez to Bombay in hours counted by speed times time. Chapter 1, the bet.

loot.name: Supply Scale
loot.description: Passepartout's list: 1778 bread counted by 3 per head, coal per mile. Keep the factor on both sides. Chapter 2, the scaling.

loot.name: Zone Dial
loot.description: Dial that turns 15 degrees into one hour. East forward, west back. Chapter 3, longitude.

loot.name: Date Line Slip
loot.description: The slip Fogg did not count: 360 degrees east gains one day. Chapter 3, the calendar jump.

loot.name: World Ribbon
loot.description: Aouda's ribbon of continents and oceans, the rail where the sea ends. Chapter 4, the world.

loot.name: Globe Seal
loot.description: Fogg's nod when legs are named, hours proved, zones stated, and wonder asked honestly. Legendary circumnavigation clear.
